name: Galaxy-Score health improvement (within-asset z) while still uncrowded — long
rationale: LunarCrush's Galaxy Score blends an asset's price action and social health into one rank, but its RAW level drifts and differs wildly across coins, so a fitted raw-level floor is the always-true trap (the phase0 social-signal §4 problem). The registered galaxy_score_z is the WITHIN-ASSET trailing-30d z of Galaxy Score — scale-stable, point-in-time, and explicitly noted in the registry as 'no spec rests on it yet'. This spec is the honest test of whether a RISING crowd-health z carries information: the hypothesis is that an asset whose own Galaxy Score is improving sharply relative to its recent self (galaxy_score_z crossing UP through a fitted floor) is gaining genuine combined price+social health — early relative strength the crowd has not fully chased yet. The CRITICAL second leg is a crowding guard: we require social_attention_z BELOW a ceiling, because the registry's lead-lag finding is that SUSTAINED elevated social attention leads price DOWN (the crowd is already piled in). So we want improving health (galaxy_score_z up) while attention is still LOW (uncrowded) — health rising before the herd arrives, not after. Exit when galaxy_score_z deteriorates back down (health rolling over) or risk limits hit. Spot-only LONG (direction=+1), no funding leg. Disconfirmer 1: the edge must be the IMPROVEMENT (cross_up), not the altitude — if replacing the cross_up with a plain galaxy_score_z gt level filter does as well or better, the signal is 'currently healthy' (already priced), not 'getting healthier'. Disconfirmer 2: the uncrowded guard must MATTER — if dropping the social_attention_z ceiling leaves the deflated Sharpe unchanged, the crowding filter is decoration and the registry's 'no spec rests on galaxy_score_z' caution stands: the health-z alone is noise. tier1 + low-confidence until validated OOS; the Gate down-weights until it earns its place.
catalyst: galaxy_score_z crosses up (crowd-health improving vs the asset's own recent self) WHILE social attention is still low (uncrowded).
